android.extraProguardRules:
# ---- Tyre Pulse rules, appended by expo-build-properties from app.json ----
#
# React Native, expo-modules-core and react-native-svg already ship consumer
# rules that R8 applies automatically: DoNotStrip on facebook/jni/yoga, every
# NativeModule and JavaScriptModule, @ReactProp methods, native <methods>,
# the whole Expo Kotlin module system, and com.horcrux.svg. Those files were
# READ from node_modules before this was written, so nothing below duplicates
# them. This is only what the app needs on top.

# 1. CRASH REPORTS MUST STAY READABLE. The load-bearing rule.
#    R8 strips SourceFile and LineNumberTable by default, and without them a
#    Java/Kotlin frame reaching Sentry loses its file and line, so a crash on
#    a field handset becomes undiagnosable. This project has already had to
#    diagnose exactly that kind of crash from Sentry.
#    renamesourcefileattribute hides the real file names while keeping the
#    line numbers usable, so readability costs no real obfuscation.
-keepattributes SourceFile,LineNumberTable
-renamesourcefileattribute SourceFile

# 2. Attributes Kotlin reflection and the Expo module system read at runtime.
#    Expo resolves module definitions and coerces argument types reflectively,
#    so a stripped Signature or annotation shows up as a module that simply
#    fails to load, in RELEASE builds only.
-keepattributes *Annotation*,Signature,InnerClasses,EnclosingMethod,Exceptions

# 3. Sentry. @sentry/react-native 7.x ships no consumer rules; its bridge is a
#    NativeModule (covered by RN) but the SDK beneath it is reached natively
#    and reflectively. Keeping it protects the one tool that reports failures
#    in the very build configuration this change introduces.
-keep class io.sentry.** { *; }
-dontwarn io.sentry.**

# 4. OkHttp is RN's HTTP stack. okio is already covered by RN's own rules;
#    okhttp3 is not, and its optional TLS providers warn loudly.
-dontwarn okhttp3.**
-dontwarn org.conscrypt.**
-dontwarn org.bouncycastle.**
-dontwarn org.openjsse.**

# 5. Enum valueOf/values are called reflectively by RN and Expo when
#    marshalling a JS string into a Kotlin enum.
-keepclassmembers enum * {
    public static **[] values();
    public static ** valueOf(java.lang.String);
}

# 6. Parcelable CREATOR is looked up BY NAME by the framework and never
#    referenced from code, so R8 cannot see that it is used.
-keepclassmembers class * implements android.os.Parcelable {
    public static final ** CREATOR;
}
